sections.Profile:
The "Volcano" pinball machine, released in September 1981 by D. Gottlieb & Co., features a wide-body design and is part of the Gottlieb System 80 series. It includes three flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball feature. The game is themed around volcanic eruptions and disaster scenarios, with artwork by David Moore and design by John Osborne and Tom Szafransky.
